_readme: THE SHORT STRINGS EVERY SURFACE SHARES.
Four of them are the kit's and are asserted equal to it by CopyContractTests:
The rest are hand-authored facts about Strava, the two stores and the vocabulary. They
have no kit constant to be equal to, so the test asserts only that they are present and
self-consistent; docs/copy/check_release_copy.py is what enforces them over the copy.
`ciqListingTitle` is the LIVE Connect IQ listing name today. docs/channels.md has
decided the rename to "CleanJibe Wingfoil Watch App Beta"; this value flips on the day
Garmin's store shows it, and not before — every page that prints the link text is
checked against what a rider actually sees.
callToAction: analyze your wingfoil sessions free — cleanjibe.org
captionOffer: analysed with CleanJibe, free at cleanjibe.org
headline: Every flight, every jibe, every swim.

exemptions.why: the dev workbench is Jan's engine surface, not a rider's (docs/presentation.md, 'The dev workbench'): it prints the engine's own vocabulary on purpose.

"not clean · carried 18° past the axis" is the ordinary verb — the arc carried past the axis — and it is a pinned cross-platform string: web/js/viz.js writes the same sentence and verify_presentation.py holds the two together (docs/presentation.md).
the takeoff metric, and the app's own Summary-grid card: attempts that produced a flight, out of attempts. It is not the clean-jibe rate — that is CPH — and TurnAnalytics says so at length.

preferred.clean: flew through it, held its speed, and the ten seconds after it stayed quiet
preferred.dry streak: the run of turns without falling in
preferred.flew through: kept the foil the whole way through the turn — no touchdown, no swim

promise: CleanJibe reads a wingfoil session off your watch and tells you what actually happened: how much of it you spent on the foil, how long each flight lasted, your speed records, and — for every turn — whether you flew through it, touched down, or fell in.
strava: Strava lets a new app connect a limited number of riders
